title: Remake a hit
summary: Take a video that already worked, break it into shots, remake each shot with any connected model, cut it on the timeline and export.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Reference video
inputs.description: A file, a YouTube link or an Instagram video the user owns or may use.

inputs.label: What to change
inputs.description: The new subject, character, product, message or language; what must stay the same.

stages.title: Bring in the reference
stages.description: Import the source, sample frames and split it at visual cuts.

stages.title: Write the remake plan
stages.description: One shot per beat with preserve/change notes, a model and inputs per shot.

stages.title: Generate and accept shots
stages.description: Generate approved shots, inspect real output, accept one take per shot.

stages.title: Cut and export
stages.description: Assemble accepted shots, add voice, music and captions, export and review.
